default_registry.description: The default tag or registry namespace for subuser images.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for subuser commands globally.

docker_socket.description: Path to the Docker daemon socket.

subusers.description: List of subuser configurations to manage with subuser add/run commands.

subusers.items.description: Flat map of fields for each subuser item. Fields: name (string), image (string), whitelist (list of strings), environment (list of strings), verbose (bool).

subusers.items.name.description: The name of the subuser (e.g., web-browsing).

subusers.items.image.description: The Docker image reference for the subuser (e.g., iceweasel@default).

subusers.items.whitelist.description: List of file paths to whitelist for this subuser.

subusers.items.environment.description: List of environment variable definitions for this subuser.

subusers.items.verbose.description: Enable verbose output for this specific subuser.
